behaviors.trigger: The user asks for a second opinion, or a task materially needs independent review.
behaviors.completion: A resolved ask string plus type, model, effort and auth_mode values, each either explicitly supplied or an identified default, with unsupported explicit values rejected rather than replaced.
outputs: Resolved request parameters held for B3 and B4
behaviors.failure: An unsupported explicit value, or several materially different readings of the ask.
behaviors.recovery: Reject the unsupported value and name it; ask only when the readings would change the review.

behaviors.trigger: A resolved request from B1 exists and no preflight has run for it.
inputs: Operator-configured external contract path and its SHA-256
behaviors.completion: preflight.json records the advertised capability probe result and the selected auth mode; exit 0 means preflight completed, not that authentication or entitlement is proven.
prerequisites: A resolvable native Claude CLI executable
An existing external contract file matching the configured digest
effects: Spawns the Claude CLI with --version and --help only
behaviors.failure: Executable not resolvable, contract missing or digest mismatch, or a required flag not advertised.
behaviors.recovery: Report the actual gap. A preflight failure has not started a reviewer call and consumes no attempt. Do not install tools or alter saved authentication.

behaviors.trigger: Preflight completed and a reviewer attempt is authorized.
behaviors.completion: A briefing file exists containing all fourteen template sections plus the appendix, each nonempty, with the exact ask and type stated and missing or compacted context named rather than invented.
outputs: briefing.md in the intake directory, copied into the attempt directory by the helper
prerequisites: A writable intake directory outside the run directory
effects: Writes briefing text that is sent to an external reviewer process
behaviors.failure: Credentials or unredacted sensitive evidence present, or a section left as template text.
behaviors.recovery: Exclude credentials and mark redactions before invoking; a nonempty-section check cannot establish truthfulness, so review the content first.

behaviors.trigger: A validated request JSON and a complete briefing exist and fewer than two attempts have been consumed.
inputs: A new or existing run directory
behaviors.completion: Exactly one reviewer process ran and the attempt directory holds started.json, preflight.json, raw stdout.txt, raw stderr.txt and execution.json; response.md exists only when the response was valid.
outputs: Immutable normalized request.json at the run root
attempt-00N directory with receipts and raw output
effects: Spawns one Claude CLI reviewer process with read-only tools and a budget cap
Reserves half the declared total budget for the attempt whether or not it succeeds
behaviors.failure: Nonzero exit, spawn error, timeout, malformed stream, stale lock, or an incomplete prior attempt.
behaviors.recovery: Retain all evidence without rollback claims. A consumed failed attempt stays consumed. Investigate an uncertain cleanup before any further attempt; never relax flags or enable write tools to recover.

behaviors.trigger: A reviewer attempt returned and its receipts are present.
behaviors.completion: Process success, response structural validity, reviewer verdict and evidence adequacy are each stated as separate conclusions, with all_unverified reported when CLAIM AUDIT carries no recognized status or only UNVERIFIED.
outputs: A stated verdict with its structural and evidential qualifications
prerequisites: A completed attempt with retained raw output
behaviors.failure: Invalid framing, duplicate or missing verdict, or an error envelope carrying plausible Markdown.
behaviors.recovery: Treat the response as invalid advice and report why; structural validity alone never establishes semantic completeness.

behaviors.trigger: A verdict has been interpreted, or both attempts are spent without one.
behaviors.completion: A report states the ask, execution status, response validity, verdict when valid, concrete recommendations, the calling agent's own assessment, evidence limitations and absolute artifact paths, distinguishing a suggestion from an applied change, executed QA and framework acceptance.
effects: May lead the calling agent to change already authorized work within its existing scope
behaviors.failure: Evidence contradicts the advice, or both attempts are spent with the conflict unresolved.
behaviors.recovery: Explain the discrepancy and use any remaining attempt with --reason reconcile; if none remains, report the unresolved conflict rather than starting a third call.

resources.purpose: Shared purpose, request resolution, verdict handling, follow-up bounds and reporting contract.
resources.load_when: Always, when the skill is invoked.

resources.purpose: Host execution contract: executable resolution, request schema usage, run layout, budgets, transports and receipts.
resources.load_when: Before preflight or any reviewer invocation.

resources.purpose: Rules for filling the briefing template without inventing or omitting evidence.
Reviewer response framing and how the calling agent interprets envelope, verdict and claim audit.
resources.load_when: After an attempt returns, before stating a verdict.

resources.purpose: Package checks and the evidence-only JSONL evaluation obligations.
resources.load_when: Only for package evaluation, never during an ordinary review.

resources.purpose: The fourteen-section briefing structure plus appendix.

resources.load_when: When building or validating a request JSON.

resources.purpose: Preflight probe and single reviewer invocation with receipt writing.
resources.load_when: Invoked by the calling agent for preflight and run; never imported for its text.

helper_contract.inputs: preflight: --claude PATH, --auth-mode MODE. run: --request FILE, --briefing FILE, --run-dir DIR, optional --reason and --show-progress.
helper_contract.outputs: preflight.json; an immutable normalized run request.json; attempt-00N/{started.json,preflight.json,stdout.txt,stderr.txt,execution.json}; result.json for strictly framed progress streams; response.md only for a valid successful response.
helper_contract.runtime: Python 3.10+ standard library and a resolvable native Claude CLI executable.
helper_contract.effects: Spawns one Claude CLI reviewer process with shell=False, read-only tools and a per-attempt budget cap; creates and holds an exclusive run-directory lock. Writes only inside the selected run directory.
helper_contract.errors: Exit 0 preflight completed or response syntax valid; 1 a recorded attempt failed or produced invalid output; 2 input, preflight or history blocked execution. No exit code is an acceptance decision.
helper_contract.reuse_reason: Called by the calling agent for B2 and B4; deterministic receipt writing and budget reservation are reused by every attempt and follow-up.

resources.purpose: Strict stream-json transport and progress rendering for --show-progress attempts.
resources.load_when: Imported by advisor_run.py when progress mode is selected.

helper_contract.inputs: Parsed CLI arguments and the resolved reviewer command supplied by advisor_run.py.
helper_contract.outputs: Retained raw stdout JSONL and a parsed terminal envelope written as result.json.
helper_contract.effects: Drains child stdout and stderr concurrently under one monotonic deadline and prints an allowlisted progress subset to stderr. Writes only inside the current attempt directory.
helper_contract.errors: Malformed JSON, duplicate member names, nonfinite values, a missing or duplicate terminal result, or events after the result make the response invalid.
helper_contract.reuse_reason: Imported by advisor_run.py so stream framing and cleanup observation are shared by all progress attempts.

resources.purpose: Thin Windows PowerShell launcher for the run command.
resources.load_when: Only on Windows when a PowerShell entry point is preferred; preflight uses Python directly.

helper_contract.outputs: Child stdout and stderr, kept separate.
helper_contract.effects: Invokes the sibling Python runner with an argument array. It writes nothing of its own.
helper_contract.errors: Exits with the child's native status; a launcher failure before Python starts exits 2.
helper_contract.reuse_reason: Alternative entry to B4 on Windows; avoids rebuilding the argument array at each invocation.

adverse_conditions.condition: The external contract file is absent, unreadable, or its SHA-256 differs from the configured digest.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: Preflight reports the mismatch and no reviewer call starts; no attempt is consumed.
adverse_conditions.requirement_basis: references/execution.md#Local execution contract; references/response-format.md digest recheck

adverse_conditions.condition: The reviewer process exceeds the configured timeout.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: The direct child is terminated, cleanup observations are recorded, no response.md is produced, and the attempt stays consumed.

adverse_conditions.condition: A stale lock or an incomplete prior attempt is present in the run directory.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: Execution is blocked for investigation rather than retried or cleaned automatically.

adverse_conditions.condition: The reviewer returns a structurally valid response whose CLAIM AUDIT holds only UNVERIFIED statuses.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: all_unverified is reported true and the advice is treated as unsupported even when the verdict is PROCEED.

adverse_conditions.condition: Both reviewer attempts are consumed and repository evidence still contradicts the advice.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: The unresolved conflict is reported; no third call is started under another request ID and no budget is raised.

adverse_conditions.condition: The native Claude CLI is not resolvable on the host.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: The actual gap is reported as a dependency limitation; nothing is installed and saved authentication is unchanged.

execution_limits.source_basis: references/execution.md default timeout of 300 seconds, range 1 to 1800

open_questions.question: Where should a Claude Code deployment resolve the required external reviewer contract? The Codex source hardcodes one operator's path under a .codex directory, which cannot be carried into a portable package. The converted skill treats the path as operator-configured and discovered at preflight; a canonical default location for Claude Code installs has not been selected.
